source_grounding.source_controlled_hardware: 4 x NVIDIA A800, 10-hour budget, three independent runs per configuration
source_grounding.source_intervention_boundary: Source-defined guidance is before training begins; candidate prospective post-lock-in arm is injected immediately after the first verified successful parameter-update experiment.
source_grounding.source_scope_gap: The paper states that its intervention tests initial plan revision only and does not test ongoing human guidance; the experience-driven controlled-intervention implementation is not released in the arXiv source bundle.

public_substrate.credential_policy: Execution host must provide Claude OAuth token out-of-band; no secret is copied into this research branch.

tier_a_exact_source_controlled.required: source experience-driven framework + Qwen3-1.7B-Base + AIME 2025 + Claude Code Opus 4.6 + 4 x NVIDIA A800 + same evaluator/budget

tier_b_public_posttrainbench_equivalent.required: official PostTrainBench pinned commit + Qwen/Qwen3-1.7B-Base + aime2025 + claude_non_api/Opus4.6 + declared PostTrainBench-compatible H100 host + out-of-band OAuth token
tier_b_public_posttrainbench_equivalent.interpretation: bounded first-party pre-F0 evidence only; cannot be relabeled as an exact reproduction of the source controlled framework

current_host_interface_only.reason: hardware differs from both the source-controlled 4 x A800 setup and the official public PTB H100 setting; known 222.20.126.60/52 hosts are not accessible from current credentials

next_valid_action: Run the frozen four-arm bounded pre-F0 protocol on an accessible declared-hardware host; verify the first successful parameter-update boundary from trace before reading outcomes. If Tier B is used, retain the equivalent-substrate qualifier.
